status: Immutable upstream source identities and binary archive selections; execution is evidenced separately per build

build_policy.configuration: Release backend libraries; separate debug Mettle compiler configuration
build_policy.linker: LLD for supported ELF/COFF/Wasm profiles; platform linker permitted for Mach-O
build_policy.reason: A fixed supported baseline, not a claim that these are the latest releases
build_policy.upgrade_gate: Document compatibility reason, update immutable source IDs, rerun build/ABI/semantic/runtime acceptance

compatibility_upgrade.reason: Resolve Darwin sanitizer reentrant initialization before main on macOS 26.4+ without disabling instrumentation or mixing host runtime versions

required_records: Archive digests and installed tool executable hashes/version output
Source input hashes, commands, exit statuses and logs
Host/target identity and selected SDK/sysroot file hashes
Object/link/run fixture result and same-environment clean rebuild artifact comparison
limits: Prebuilt upstream tools are not a local build from the selected source commits
Recorded guest package versions are not an immutable apt repository
Emulated Linux execution is not native hardware/performance evidence
Foundation checks do not establish Mettle source compilation or release/platform qualification
